_about: Hand corrections of model-extracted node fields (tissue_n, n, cases, controls, platform), applied when nodes are built. Each entry says why and cites the evidence. Entries 'why' starting '2026-09-27 paper check' come from corpus/node_check_2026-09-27/ (every drawn study checked against its full text; checked_*.tsv has the per-field verdicts and quotes). Entries 'why' containing '2026-09-29 N audit' apply analyses/extraction_audit_2026-09-28/n_audit/proposed_n_fixes.json under Paul's rulings.
